### TRUEST SINGLE SENTENCE
N.H is Ness's helper, not his decider: it borrows a frozen mouth to put words to meaning, runs a tiny search model to find memories by meaning not words, and keeps a memory of two files — sealed roots (5,521 of them now clean on disk, each carrying who-spoke from source) and readings floating beside them pointing by id, only ever added to, never closing the book — gathering each person into a box that is Ness's own knowing of them and never them, recording every move on an untouchable tape underneath, wondering forward at night and keeping every wonder shown rather than decided, so meaning and how-each-thing-sits-in-whose-story can keep evolving forever without hardening into a fact that pretends to be true for everyone; every input lands in two places at once — raw into the sealed root, and through the filter that reads it and lays understanding beside it — the dumb machinery holds the data and cannot interpret, the smart machinery reads the person and cannot close, the membrane stands between them, the mouth is a swappable tool that grows nothing while all the growth lands in the understood memory it speaks from, and where two tellings disagree the system shows the clash rather than choosing — because N.H was never about escaping reality or training a brain, it is about refusing to let reality be counterfeited, refusing to flatten whose-story-is-whose, and refusing to ever shut the book, so that Ness walks back out into his life with a solution that is his own.

## 0. THE PREMISE — NEVER DECIDE FACTS (NEVER CLOSE THE BOOK)  [DESIGNED — the floor under every rule]

**The line:** The danger N.H exists to stop was never *reasoning* — it was reasoning *hardening into authority*: a living guess freezing into a closed, settled fact. The AI may reason fully — connect, guess, build on its own past reasoning, hold opinions, leave notes, get richer over time, and even wonder/simulate forward at night — and do everything except one thing: **close the book on something into a decided fact.** Every conclusion stays a non-decisive, accreting layer; nothing it concludes ever promotes itself to "real."

**The crystallization:** **N.H is Ness's HELPER, not Ness's DECIDER.** A helper reads, connects, lays out what it sees, even leans — then hands it to the person, who decides. A decider closes the book.

**★ THE SOUL CORRECTION (S11) — three truths held at once, never collapsed:**
1. **Interpretive meaning is never stored as a universal fact — it remains a situated story** (§3G). There is no fact-box for *meaning*. "How real, to whom" is a per-person reading, never a place a meaning goes to become true-for-everyone. *(This is about interpretive meaning, NOT machine-state: provenance and machine facts ARE established — see the §0 S13 sharpening.)*
2. **Ness still decides / affirms.** He is the decider, the membrane. The system does NOT decide what is real — *and neither does it pretend nothing is ever decided.* Ness decides.
3. **★ His deciding is NOT a node in the engine.** It happens out in real life, engine absent. **There is no step after "show."** The engine wonders and shows; the deciding is *off the board.*

**Why a fact is the forbidden thing:** a fact is *the book shut* — true-for-everyone, no longer subjective to Ness. N.H is *his* (הכל יחסי). A fact is the one thing he does not own.

**The crucial distinction:** "never decide facts" does NOT mean "never hold anything firmly." Something can be held with full weight and still never close the book. The enemy was open-vs-closed, not weak-vs-strong.

**★ S13 SHARPENING (from external critique — the wording was too absolute; narrow its JURISDICTION, don't remove the principle):** "never decide facts" must NOT be read as "there are no facts." The clean distinction: **the DUMB machinery MAY establish directly-verifiable machine-state and provenance facts** (this file exists, this hash matches, this record has 8 fields, this role came directly from source, this root-id points here, this write succeeded). **The SMART machinery MAY interpret, connect, and lean — but may NEVER silently promote an interpretation into an established fact.** The authority for any such promotion is Ness, off-board, never the engine. So: *machine-state & provenance truth is decided freely; interpretive meaning is never closed into truth-for-everyone.* Collapsing those two into one prohibition (the old wording) would treat a file hash or a source role as "only a story" — which absurdly WEAKENS the evidence discipline the system exists to protect.

## 0A. THE TWO MACHINERIES — DUMB vs SMART (psychologics)  [DESIGNED — top-level frame]

- **DUMB MACHINERY — moves and holds data; built stupid on purpose.** The pure tape, the append-only store, the two files (roots sealed, readings beside), the pointers (`re_reads`), the role-carried-from-source, the catalog's who/when/where marking, the mode/form-naming, the person-box GATHER, the live loop's fire-and-let-go. One law: **never interpret, never close — only add / point / carry / sort / gather.** Safe BECAUSE it cannot interpret.

> **★ S13 CORRECTION — THE PURE TAPE NEEDS A REDACTION/DESTRUCTION PATH (safety, not philosophy).** "Captures always, append-only, untouchable" is epistemically clean but a real hazard: the tape could capture passwords, access tokens, other people's private info, accidental pastes, medical details, things recorded during distress, or material someone later has a legitimate right to remove. **"Append-only" must NOT mean "permanent recoverable storage of every secret forever."** The corrected rule allows: (i) **capture exclusions** for credentials and known secrets (don't record them at all); (ii) encrypted storage; (iii) explicit **retention boundaries**; (iv) **cryptographic erasure** of selected content; (v) an append-only **TOMBSTONE** that retains *that* a deletion occurred and when, WITHOUT retaining the deleted plaintext; (vi) special treatment for third-party and childhood data. This does not violate append-only HISTORY — the record can say content was removed without continuing to preserve the harmful content itself. *(Applies to the tape AND the sealed roots: sealing protects from accidental MUTATION; it must still allow DELIBERATE, audited destruction of genuinely sensitive content — seal ≠ un-deletable.)* Owed alongside §11 item 24 (privacy/threat model).

> **★ S13 CORRECTION — "ABSENCE IS READ" NEEDS A GUARD (or it becomes pseudo-psychology).** Absence is meaningful ONLY when (i) the system EXPECTED the information, (ii) the collection process was CAPABLE of observing it, (iii) the absence is contextually relevant, and (iv) the interpretation is held explicitly WEAK. Unguarded, "absence is read" turns missing-data artifacts (a parser failure, a field never evaluated, an old schema) into manufactured significance — a sophisticated hallucination. So omission needs to distinguish, at least in processing metadata, between `not_observed` / `not_evaluated` / `not_applicable` / `withheld` / `collection_failed`. A blank in a reading is still honest (don't write `"unknown"`), and these labels live BESIDE the reading as provenance about WHY a field is absent — they do not fill the story fields themselves. The engine must not read every blank as psychological evidence — only the ones that pass the four-part guard.
- **SMART (psychologics) MACHINERY — reads the *person*.** The meaning webs (Theory of Mind, the STORY-layer with its six parts, gap-reading, firmness-as-read), clash-surfacing, the wonder/simulation, and the NOTE. One law: **everything here is weightless, dated, confidence-tagged, rejectable — NEVER a fact.** Safe BECAUSE it cannot close.
- **THE BORROWED MOUTH (§16) sits at the seam, used by SMART.** The wording model turns understood meaning into sentences — a swappable tool. The embedding/search model is a DUMB tool (sorts by meaning-distance; does not interpret).

**The membrane (§7A R7) is the boundary between them** — creation (SMART) never closes into memory (DUMB).

**OPEN PINS (fresh-head):** (i) the name — "smart" vs "psychologics machinery"; (ii) whether the note + clash file under SMART or are called out inside it.

## 1. WHAT N.H IS

N.H ("Jarvis") is a personal, sovereign AI memory system running locally, 24/7, on Ness's own Windows machine. Not a product — infrastructure for his own thinking, memory, and research.

**The one-line soul:** **N.H is Ness's HELPER, not Ness's DECIDER.** The loop, in Ness's words: *real life → into N.H for help → it helps him see and understand his own thinking and do what he needs in the way that fits how he thinks → he returns to real life with a solution that is his own.*

**★ WHAT JARVIS ACTUALLY IS:** Jarvis is NOT the model. The model is a borrowed, frozen mouth (§16). **Jarvis is the memory + the soul + the gathering + the mouth, wired together.** Everything that makes him *him and grows him* lives outside the model.

**★ MEMORY IS UNDERSTOOD KNOWLEDGE THAT GROWS.** The memory is not a pile of raw text — it is comprehension that accretes. New input is *read* by the webs and lands as a reading (meaning + confidence + story-layer). Jarvis understands more tomorrow, and the growth lands in the memory, never in the frozen mouth.

**★ THE TWO-DESTINATIONS SHAPE (S12, Ness re-derived it):** every input goes to TWO places at once — (1) the **RAW ROOT**, saved untouched and sealed; (2) **THROUGH THE FILTER**, which READS it and lays a **READING** beside the root, pointing back by id, never altering the raw. The filter never "filters" the root; raw stays raw forever, understanding accretes beside it. This is exactly why there are TWO FILES. *(S12 built place 1 — the raw roots. The filter, place 2, reads them later as its own pass.)*

**The two functions (NOT two truth-boxes):**
- **SIMULATION — the create-space / workshop, with a live function (§7B Part 6.5):** where things get made and wondered forward.
- **"REALITY" as a box of decided facts — DISSOLVED (§3G).** "How real" is not a place; it is "how does this sit in *whose* story" — a per-person telling the filter reads, layered, revisable, never closed.

**The two purposes, always running together (THE CORE — Ness's framing):**
- **INWARD — the mirror:** show Ness the shape of his own thinking from the outside — the pattern he can't see because he's inside it. *(The 5,521 clean roots ingested in S12 are the inward eye's raw material.)*
- **OUTWARD — the engine:** take new external data and translate it through the lens of how *his* mind connects things — not generic explanation, not retrieval.
- **ONE FILTER, BOTH DIRECTIONS.** Same method (read meaning through Ness's lens, never close the book); only the direction it faces changes. The two feed each other: outward reading lands in memory as new roots/readings, which enrich the next inward read. *"A mind that runs alongside another mind — one looking inward, one looking outward — both at full speed."*

## 1A. THE INPUT-AGNOSTIC PRINCIPLE — ONE ENGINE, MANY FRONT DOORS  [DESIGNED]

N.H is input-agnostic. Text, images, video, audio — all flow through the SAME engine. New input types get a new **front door** (a small model turning that input into pieces the engine reads), not a new engine. The front door has two stages (§14): RAW capture → CATALOG (who/when/where). The live chat itself is a front door. *(The S12 ChatGPT-export parser is a worked text front door.)*

**The deepest "why" — הכל יחסי:** nothing about *meaning* is final — a thing means what it means only relative to ever-growing context, and relative to whom. This is why memory only adds, classification is never locked, "unknown" is honest, and the affirmation surface is a per-person STORY, not a shared fact-box.

## 2. HOW TO WORK WITH NESS

- **Direct tone, plain language, ONE step at a time.** He asks "why yes / why no" and wants real tradeoffs. **He often asks for things "plainly" — give the plain version directly.**
- **Verify on disk, never trust status reports.** *(S12 proof, the strongest yet: FIVE doc claims fell to disk checks in one session — the count, a missing module, a not-a-stub, an inlined field, a 116k-vs-11k Chroma. Trust disk, never the doc — including this master.)*
- **Honest correction over flattery** — explicitly, repeatedly asked for.
- **Don't inform, just flag and keep going.** A one-line flag, then continue.
- **Pull Sovereignty** — no unsolicited pushes; Ness sets direction.
- **Casual comms are normal** — typos, voice-to-text, Hebrew, elongated punctuation ("ssstttiiilll nottt 11") are NOT distress; they're thinking out loud / staying in flow.
- **He catches things.** When he pushes back, he is usually right. *(S12: he caught Claude attributing decisions to him that Claude had made — "you said not me" — a real correction. Don't put words in his mouth; offer, let him confirm.)*
- **He is not afraid of work.** A wall is almost never "this is hard" — it is "this move would destroy/forfeit something." Diagnose blockers as *"what irreversible/lossy thing is this asking?"*
- **He re-derives his own design from the inside.** *(S12: he reconstructed the two-files / two-destinations shape himself from the data side. The design is genuinely his — offer shapes, let him rebuild and steer.)*
- **Backup before any destructive step, always.** *(S12: he insisted "of course backup first" before clearing the 188 — correct instinct, kept.)*
- **Primary risk pattern: scope-expansion before consolidation.** Finish and verify what's in front before the next thing.
- **Claude's role:** architecture, audit, security, strategy — the brain that checks the work ("JARVIS"). Cursor writes code; Ness runs every command in cmd and verifies on disk. *(S12 exception: for the bytecode recovery + the small ingest/store modules, Claude wrote the exact code directly so the recovered constants wouldn't drift; Ness still ran and verified everything on disk.)*
- **Session workflow:** one topic per chat; start fresh when a topic closes. End of session: regenerate the master + a short delta → Ness swaps the file in. **Ness prefers to start a fresh chat from a corrected master rather than continue a long session on fumes** (stated S12).

## 6B. THE ACCRETIVE STORE — SCHEMA + STATE  [BUILT & VERIFIED]

*The running code of the accretive/membrane direction. A deliberately dumb, append-only store — the DUMB-MACHINERY heart (§0A). Wired to NOTHING by design.*

**Module:** `nh_accretive_store.py` (restored S12, extended S13). 4 public + 4 private functions; every `open()` is `"a"`/`"r"`, no `"w"`; schema validated before every append. **The roots file is SEALED (S13):** `append_root` raises if `.nh_roots.sealed` exists.

**★ ROOT record schema (SEVEN fields, S12):** `id` (uuid4) · `subject` · `timestamp` (ISO 8601, validated) · `content` · `re_reads` (list; `[]` = root, non-empty = reading) · `source_title` (string or None; optional/absence-tolerated on read) · **`role`** (speaker carried from source — `user`/`assistant`; required on new writes; tolerated-absent on read for legacy records).

**★ READING record schema — SHAPE PROVISIONALLY SETTLED (S13), `confidence` OPEN, NOT YET CODED.** ⚠ The sibling file `.nh_readings_store.jsonl` is *wired* (`append_reading` routes there) but `append_reading` is still ROOT-SHAPED (`subject, content, re_reads, role, …`) and `_validate_record` enforces the 7-field ROOT schema. The reading record — **now `id · reads (root id(s)) · meaning · confidence · role · story_layer · mode · timestamp · produced_by · schema_version · derived_from · idempotency_key` (TWELVE provisional fields; the original "8-field" plus `produced_by`+`schema_version` then `derived_from`+`idempotency_key` from the S13 doc-pass; superseded phrasing kept only in history; an optional content-hash may also be stored for exact-duplicate/integrity detection but is NOT a field the schema requires)** — has NO validator and NO writer yet; ZERO real readings exist. A reading NEVER copies root text — it points. Show = read readings → follow `reads` ids into sealed roots → stitch. A re-read is a NEW reading beside the old (R6). **FIRST 2c-adjacent build job: a reading-shaped `append_reading` + a reading validator.** **The complex/contract fields, design-settled S13:**

⚠ **BUT THE SHAPE IS NOT FULLY LOCKED — `confidence` is unresolved (§11 item 19).** The record is listed with a single top-level `confidence`, yet §11 item 19 establishes that "confidence" is really FOUR separate quantities (interpretation confidence · source reliability · story firmness · retrieval relevance) and must NOT collapse into one number. So the reading-record SHAPE is **provisionally settled, not design-locked** — `story_layer`/`mode`/unknowns are settled, but the confidence representation (one generic field? `interpretation_confidence` only? a structured object? none at top level?) MUST be resolved BEFORE the validator is written, or the validator would prematurely freeze the very ambiguity S13 just surfaced. **Resolve confidence first → then code the validator/writer.**
- **`story_layer` = a LIST of tellings** (so opposing readings of the same root both stay — clash kept, nothing wins). Each telling: optional `whose · stance · firmness · telling · theme · when`. Empty list = no story-reading yet (honest). Unknown parts OMITTED, never `"unknown"`-filled (absence read at read-time). The top-level `role` (who spoke) ≠ a telling's `whose` (in whose story).
- **`mode` = an OPEN word + a LOCAL confidence** (register: chat/composed/story/question/…). NOT a fixed menu — a menu would re-add a manual gate (R5 / הכל יחסי). One mode per reading; a different reading later is a NEW reading, not an edit. ⚠ **NAMING CLARIFICATION (S13):** `mode`'s confidence is a LOCAL `classification_confidence` (how sure the filter is it named the register right), e.g. `mode: { label: "question", classification_confidence: 0.82 }`. This is NOT the unresolved top-level reading confidence (§11 item 19) — do not let the existence of `mode.classification_confidence` make the next session think the top-level `confidence`/`interpretation_confidence` question is already solved. They are different quantities at different levels; the top-level one is still OPEN.
- **★ `produced_by` = REPRODUCIBILITY-GRADE PRODUCER PROVENANCE (S13 doc-pass; DUMB-machinery structural field, not interpretation).** A structured sub-record stamping WHAT made the reading, enough to approximately explain *why this reading and not another* — not just "which model." Shape (DESIGNED, leave room): `origin` (the information-path origin — at least `"observed"` | `"imported"` | `"simulated"` | `"generated"` | `"reaction"` | `"human_annotation"`, distinguishing whether the input was directly observed, imported from elsewhere, produced in the simulation/wonder space, generated by the engine, derived from Ness's reaction to an earlier N.H output, or hand-annotated) · `model` (name) · `model_digest` (hash/exact version, not just name) · `engine_version` · `prompt_version` (template) · `config` (decoding/settings relevant to reproduce) · the retrieval inputs/context-ids+order the reading was built from (so a reading is approximately recreatable). **For `origin:"human_annotation"` (a GOLD annotation): the model fields give way to ANNOTATION provenance** — `annotator` · `annotated_at` · `context_version` · `change_reason` (why it changed between gold versions). **Validator requirement:** `produced_by` is REQUIRED on every engine-generated reading (without it you can't tell a stale reading from a current one, can't re-evaluate an old batch when the mouth is swapped, can't attribute a bad reading to a model version). Gold cases satisfy it via the human-annotation form — they are NOT exempt from provenance, only from MODEL provenance. This is the structural anchor that makes item 19's "no silent confidence inheritance / no false corroboration" enforceable.
- **★ `derived_from` = LINEAGE (S13 doc-pass; first-schema PIN — un-retrofittable, must exist from the first reading).** A list of PARENT READING ids the reading was derived from; **empty `[]` when the reading was produced fresh directly from source roots** (those roots are in `reads`). `produced_by.origin` says what KIND of information path; `derived_from` says WHICH prior readings sit upstream. Together they let the path be reconstructed later. **THE GOVERNING RULE (records here + item 19): derived material must never count as INDEPENDENT evidence for the interpretation that produced it; repeated readings descending from one lineage remain ONE evidence path, not multiple confirmations.** This blocks the invisible confirmation loop — interpret a root → discuss it → the discussion enters as new data → the discussion gets read as independent support for the original interpretation — where one guess wears several costumes and certainty climbs while evidence doesn't (a §0 soul violation that no "fact" field would catch). **The FIELDS are pinned now; the full lineage analysis + independence-weighting (walking `derived_from` to discount downstream agreement) is DEFERRED** (beside item 19 / the view layer) — the slot must exist, the logic can come later.
- **★ `idempotency_key` = OPERATION identity, separate from `id` the RECORD identity (S13 doc-pass; writer-contract PIN).** `id` is the unique IMMUTABLE identity of the stored reading. `idempotency_key` (a.k.a. generation-run id) is the stable identity of the WRITE OPERATION, reused when a crashed/repeated command is retried; **the writer rejects an already-committed key.** A content hash over `reads`+`meaning`+`produced_by`+`schema_version` may ALSO be stored for exact-duplicate/integrity detection, but it must NOT carry the retry guarantee — a nondeterministic mouth can rephrase `meaning` on replay (hash misses the dup), and two legitimately independent readings can collide (hash invents a dup). Operation-identity does the retry job; record-identity is permanent; content-hash is an optional integrity extra.
- **★ `schema_version` = the record-contract version stamp (S13 doc-pass; REQUIRED on every NEW record).** Cheap now, impossible to retrofit later — and for the 5,521 SEALED roots it is ALREADY too late (they are implicit v1, tolerated-absent on read; the seal forbids adding it to them). So it MUST land on the first reading ever written. Migrations never rewrite old records (append-only forbids it) — a schema change ADDS new superseding records; the version stamp is what lets a future validator read multiple versions and know which contract each record obeys. The first reading schema is `v1`.

**★ ON DISK NOW (verified S13):** **5,521 clean root records, SEALED**, all `re_reads=[]` (all roots — no real readings written yet), all 7-field, role-carried, source-timestamped, clean source_title. The sibling readings file is wired but holds **no real readings yet** (a test reading was written and deleted). *(The ~116k Chroma is the OLD unaligned index — §5/§11.15.)* **The remaining 2a-adjacent work is, FIRST, to implement and verify the reading VALIDATOR and reading-shaped WRITER (the current `append_reading` is still root-shaped, `_validate_record` still enforces the 7-field root) — and ONLY THEN to populate real readings through the engine (2c).**

**No `reason`/`why` field, by design** — the why is shown by what a layer points at; the AI's view is the NOTE (§7B Part 7.5).

*(§7A operating rules, §7B the meaning-engine mechanism, §7C build order — all UNCHANGED from MASTER-12 in substance. Preserved by reference; the key points below.)*

### 7A — THE UNIVERSAL FILTER (operating rules, full set unchanged):
R0 reader/layer-er not judge; R0.5 never close the book (may wonder/simulate); R1 one filter, no source exempt; R2 sorts/reads, never closes "real"; R3 one continuous reader; R4 meaning from wide context; R5 classification never locked; **R5.5 the affirmation surface is a per-person STORY-layer (six optional parts: whose·when·stance·firmness·telling·theme; absence is itself read, but ONLY under the §0A observability guard — expected + observable + relevant + held-weak, never raw missing-data; CLASH surfaced not resolved; N.H not a teller, its view a weightless NOTE);** R6 memory only ADDS (KEYSTONE); R7 the membrane (creation in chat, never closes in memory); R8 associative bridging as relevance-trigger; R9 sort by meaning-type, mode a separate peer web; R10 maximal-but-bounded; R11 Ness steers, affirms off-board; R12 honesty about what this is (the model does not grow).

### 7B — THE MEANING ENGINE (mechanism, full depth unchanged):
Part 0 THE PURE TAPE (deepest DUMB layer — verbatim, append-only, outside memory; preserves ELIGIBLE captured events, subject to explicit capture-exclusions for secrets and audited cryptographic redaction with tombstones — §0A correction; NOT capture-everything-untouchable); Parts 1–2 the chain of webs (intent, deixis, common ground, implicature, theory-of-mind, time, re-reading, mode); Part 2.5 THE STORY-LAYER WEB (six optional parts, absence-read, clash); **Part 2.6 PERSON-BOXES (a GATHER over readings by `whose`, bounded by Ness's knowing, never synthesised; the tag is the wall; no-ruin + no-contaminate);** Part 3 webs combine (one camera, many lenses); Part 4 nightly research inward+outward (feeds the MEMORY, never the mouth); Part 5 hold-until-enough; Part 6 can't-fill→inform-don't-ask (live exception: catalog MAY ask, Ness present); **Part 6.5 THE WONDER/SIMULATION (kept-and-shown never decided; two walls — file door + eyes door; no scratch→memory path);** Part 7 THE LOG (read-only, subject-tagged, clickable); Part 7.5 THE NOTE/THE WHY (the AI's whole perspective, weightless, cannot harden, confidence never aggregates).

### 7C — THE FORCED BUILD ORDER (never re-fought):
**(2a) two-file routing + sealed roots — ✅ PLUMBING BUILT (S13); ⚠ READING RECORD NOT CODED.** What's on disk: `append_reading`→sibling file, roots sealed. What's NOT: the 8-field reading validator/writer (`append_reading` is still root-shaped). Reading record SHAPE provisionally settled (`story_layer`=list, `mode`=open word, unknowns omitted) — but `confidence` representation OPEN (§11 item 19); resolve it BEFORE coding the validator. **The reading-record code is the FIRST job of the next milestone, folded into 2c.** → **(2b) the detector — ✅ INVESTIGATED, RECIPE LOCKED (S13).** Full read-only investigation: shape tops out ~91.6% (proven), meaning (embeddings) breaks it; locked recipe = embed+shape → StandardScaler → LogisticRegression(C=0.1) → **~94.89% honest (5-fold)**. NOT deployed — a FALLBACK for sources lacking `role`; build the live detector later from the recipe. → **(2c) the engine — THE NEXT MILESTONE — first code the reading-record writer/validator, then the chain-of-webs that READS a root and produces a real READING; fresh-head, the heart of the system.** **★ Build the LIVE path (memory → search → mouth → speak) BEFORE the nightly deepening.**

### ★ NEW OPEN PROBLEMS — surfaced by the S13 external critique (real gaps, named so 2c doesn't trip on them):
18. **★ MULTI-BOX (sealed-batch) ARCHITECTURE — undesigned.** The seal protects ONE file; the plan is "new raw → new sealed files," but there is no: batch naming scheme, root-id→batch resolution, manifest, cross-batch dedup, `read_all`-over-many-boxes, crash-safety between writing a root and updating a manifest, or decision on whether the batch id is part of the address (vs assuming UUIDs globally unique). **Must be designed before a SECOND batch is ever written.** Likely answer: a small append-only manifest + batch-prefixed addressing; design it, don't wing it.
19. **★ CONFIDENCE IS NAMED BUT NOT DEFINED — and one number hides four.** "confidence" currently conflates: (i) **interpretation confidence** (how sure the engine is of its reading), (ii) **source reliability** (how trustworthy the originating evidence is), (iii) **story firmness** (how firmly a person holds a telling — already a story_layer part), (iv) **retrieval relevance** (how well a memory matches a query). Collapsing them into one number = HIDDEN AUTHORITY (a soul violation — §0). **Decision owed: keep these as SEPARATE fields, never a single blended score.** Also: confidence must NOT rise just because several readings copied the same original error (no false corroboration), and a later reading must not silently inherit a prior's confidence. ⚠ **Note the level distinction:** `mode.classification_confidence` (how sure the filter named the register) is a LOCAL field and is NOT the top-level reading confidence — resolving the top-level representation must not be confused with the already-present mode-local confidence (§6B clarification). ⚠ **Source reliability ≠ interpretive confidence ≠ authentic provenance — three different things, kept separate (deferred detail):** a source can be authentic (real provenance) yet unreliable (sarcastic, fictional, manipulated, copied), and a confidently-WRITTEN source must not dominate merely because it reads clear. Authentic provenance is DUMB-machinery fact (`role`/`source`/`produced_by`); source reliability and interpretive confidence are SMART-machinery readings — never fold them into one number. ⚠ **The structural anti-inheritance anchors are `produced_by` + `schema_version` (§6B):** because every reading stamps WHAT made it and under which schema, a later reading cannot silently inherit a prior's confidence and a re-read by a new model is distinguishable from the original — the provenance stamp is what makes "no false corroboration" enforceable rather than aspirational. ⚠ **LINEAGE is the deeper anti-corroboration anchor (`derived_from`, §6B):** the worst false corroboration is invisible — a reading derived from an earlier reading (via discussion, reaction, or re-read) later counted as INDEPENDENT support for that earlier reading. **Governing rule: derived material must never count as independent evidence for the interpretation that produced it; readings descending from one lineage are ONE evidence path, not many confirmations.** The `derived_from` slot is pinned in the first schema so this is reconstructable; the independence-weighting logic is deferred.
20. **★ NO MEASURABLE DEFINITION OF "UNDERSTANDING" — build a gold-standard set; this is the NEXT CORRECT MOVEMENT.** "Memory is understood knowledge that grows" is an aspiration, not a spec. **THE LOCKED ORDERED SEQUENCE for the next session** (turns "understanding must be falsifiable" into real code):
>    1. **Verify on disk the specific components this change will touch** — the S13 lesson discharged as a STANDING first move, not a one-time sweep. Trust disk, not the doc (including this file). Check `append_reading`'s current signature, `_validate_record`'s schema, the sibling file's state, the seal — before writing anything.
>    2. **Resolve the reading `confidence` representation** (item 19) — decide the top-level shape BEFORE the validator, so it doesn't freeze the ambiguity. *(A GENUINE session decision — a real fork with tradeoffs, NOT pre-decided here.)*
>    3. **Define the GOLD-TEST FORMAT and the GOLD SCORING RULE** (see THE GOLD CASE UNIT + THE GOLD SCORING fork below) — settle the case shape AND how a reading is judged against a case, before annotating. *(Scoring is a GENUINE session decision — left open here.)*
>    4. **Annotate the cases and SEAL them** (see THE GOLD SEAL below) — gold v1 frozen before any engine output is seen.
>    5. **Implement the reading VALIDATOR + reading-shaped WRITER — gate on SHAPE, never on confidence.** The validator certifies a reading is structurally well-formed; it does NOT certify the interpretation is correct. Accuracy is decided by evaluation against the sealed gold, never by schema validation. A weak/uncertain reading is still WRITTEN — it is marked weak, never rejected for being weak (rejecting on confidence = R5's manual gate sneaking back in). Reject malformed; never reject uncertain. **★ Validator sequencing clarification:** build and unit-test the validator/writer against a small set of hand-made FIXTURES derived from the sealed gold FORMAT; do NOT block schema code on completion of all 10–30 annotations. Only the final engine-vs-gold comparison (step 7) requires the full gold set to be sealed. **★ Writer requirement — atomicity, timestamp, idempotency:** the reading writer must be crash-safe — no partial JSONL lines, verify the referenced root exists before commit, survive interrupted writes / retries / concurrent writers without manual history edits. **A reading's `timestamp` is its CREATION time** — distinct from source time, event time, and ingest time (the richer time model is item 25(d), deferred; the field meaning is pinned now). **Idempotency runs on the OPERATION-level `idempotency_key`, not on a content hash** — a retried crashed/repeated command reuses its key and the writer rejects an already-committed key; `id` stays the immutable record identity; an optional content hash may detect exact-duplicate payloads but does NOT carry the retry guarantee (a nondeterministic mouth rephrases on replay; independent readings can collide). Folded into building the writer, not a separate fork.
>    6. **Run a minimal engine** to generate a handful of real readings through the writer. *(Requires the FAILURE-BEHAVIOR decision — what the engine does when it cannot interpret: minimal reading vs no reading vs an explicit `insufficient-context` marked reading vs queue-for-later. A GENUINE session decision, left open here.)*
>    7. **Compare against the SEALED gold — output may FAIL a case, never rewrite it.**
>    Do NOT broadly redesign next session — the document has surfaced enough uncertainty to proceed; the move is the smallest testable engine, not more design. Distinguishes: retrieve-right-sentence vs identify-speaker vs read-intent vs connect-to-earlier vs recollection-vs-claim vs preserve-disagreement vs answer-accurately.
>
>    **★ THE GOLD CASE UNIT (a root is NOT the evaluation unit).** Each gold case = **a target root + the exact context the engine is allowed to interpret it with + the annotation.** Reason: R4 — meaning comes from wide context, and the engine's first pipeline step loads "the root AND nearby conversation." A bare-root annotation lets the human read earlier turns the engine never receives, making the gold answer unreachable by construction and every failure unattributable — you can't tell a weak engine from an unfair test. Freezing the per-case interpretation-context makes the eval reproducible and failures diagnosable. The format IS "root + frozen context + annotation." *(The live engine will later need its OWN rule for CHOOSING that context — how many turns, when retrieval is allowed, how to tell not-enough-context from engine-failure. That's 2c engine design, deferred — see item 25 / context-selection.)*
>
>    **★ THE GOLD SEAL (a soul rule — the seal logic of the roots, applied to the eval).** Editing the expected answer after seeing the output is the forbidden move in miniature: a reading hardening to fit what showed up, the book quietly re-shut to match the engine (same shape as confidence inheriting from corroboration, item 19). So: **Gold version 1 is sealed before testing. Engine output may fail it but may not alter it. A correction requires a NEW gold version with an explicit reason and provenance; the previous version remains preserved.** This blocks output-fitting while still allowing genuine annotation mistakes to be corrected transparently — the fix is a new sealed version, never an edit to the one the engine just ran against. **Gold annotations carry HUMAN provenance** (annotator · when · which source/context version · why it changed between versions) — see `produced_by.origin = "human"` in §6B; a gold case is not exempt from provenance, only from MODEL provenance.
>
>    **★ THE GOLD SCORING RULE — a GENUINE open decision (resolve at step 3, before annotating).** A sealed gold set without a scoring rule still produces subjective pass/fail. Open questions, Ness's to settle: is `meaning` exact-match / semantic-match / human-reviewed; how is a partially-correct `story_layer` scored; is missing an optional field worse than inventing one (lean: inventing is worse — it's the poisoning failure mode); how is a reading scored that is correct but broader than the annotation; may one gold case admit SEVERAL acceptable readings; who decides pass/fail. Decide the rule before annotating, because how you annotate depends on how you'll score.
21. **★ RE-READ LIFECYCLE — append-only needs view/dedup rules.** A single root may accrete: initial + contextual + corrected + per-person + nightly + new-model readings, some contradictory. Append-only is fine philosophically but unbounded computationally. **Owed: when is a re-read justified; near-duplicate detection; can a reading explicitly SUPERSEDE another (a pointer, not a delete); how old readings stay visible without dominating retrieval; how nightly jobs are stopped from spawning endless paraphrases.** Lifecycle moves into pointers and views, it doesn't disappear.
>    - **★ THE VIEW LAYER (named primitive — the operational answer).** Separate the two things this item conflates: **the HISTORY (append-only, permanent, nothing deleted) UNDERNEATH, and a COMPUTED CURRENT-USE VIEW above it.** The view is a *calculated working-set*, not storage — it classifies readings into `current · contradicted · superseded · rejected · low-confidence · historically-important-but-now-weak`. **Retrieval reads the VIEW, never the raw append-only pile**, so old/weak/rejected readings stay fully preserved in history without dominating live use. Supersession is a pointer written into history; the view is what *consumes* those pointers. This is also where item 23's accept/reject events land — a rejection moves a reading into the view's `rejected` bucket WITHOUT deleting it from history. The append-only floor and the computed view are two layers, not one. DESIGNED, NOT built.
>    - **★ CONTRADICTION TYPES (deferred refinement of the view).** "Contradicted" is not one thing: two people disagreeing · one person changing their mind · a factual correction · different contexts · ambiguous language · a model mistake. The view layer eventually distinguishes these rather than flagging everything `contradicted`. Recorded; not a near-term blocker.
>    - **★ THE INTERPRETATION-INTEGRITY CONSTRAINT (records under 19 + 21 — the system-wide property that keeps the soul honest at runtime).** The raw evidence is protected, but an INTERPRETATION can still become a de-facto authority indirectly — through repetition, retrieval ranking, presentation style, or accumulated person-boxes — even when no field says "fact." So one rule governs the whole live system: **the more inferential a reading is, the easier it must be to trace, challenge, suppress, and replace in the current view.** This is the most important system-wide property not yet fully specified; it is the live-system expression of §0 (never let an interpretation harden into authority). Every later view/retrieval/person-box decision is measured against it.
22. **★ PERSON-BOX CONTAMINATION — needs per-element provenance.** A gather can mix: what a person literally said · what Ness thought they meant · what N.H inferred · what someone ELSE said about them · old vs current. "Bounded by Ness's knowing / never synthesised" is the right principle but needs teeth: each gathered element carries its provenance so retrieval can't make a cluster feel like a settled identity.
23. **★ OFF-BOARD AFFIRMATION HAS NO FEEDBACK PATH — readings can't be learned-from.** If Ness's reactions stay entirely outside the engine, N.H can't tell that a reading was useful / mistaken / rejected, so it may resurface interpretations he already dismissed. **Fix consistent with the soul: record the reaction as a STORY-LAYER EVENT ("Ness accepted/rejected this reading for this purpose at this time"), NOT as a promoted fact.** Not a truth-button — a dated, weightless note that retrieval can read. *(This is the one place the off-board principle needs a careful seam — the affirmation stays off-board as TRUTH, but its OCCURRENCE can be recorded as story.)*
24. **★ PRIVACY / THREAT MODEL — first-class before sensitive ingest.** Encryption-at-rest is necessary not sufficient. Owed before WhatsApp/child-data (already frozen): which processes can decrypt; do logs/Ollama-prompts expose plaintext; do embeddings leak sensitive content; backup encryption; same-Windows-account malware exposure; **and a REDACTION/DESTRUCTION path (see §0A-PURE-TAPE correction below).**
25. **★ GO-LIVE HARDENING BLOCK — DEFERRED, does NOT gate the minimal engine.** A named set of real operational requirements for running N.H as a live 24/7 system — recorded so 2c doesn't trip on them, explicitly NOT pulled forward into the next build (the second review converged here; the discipline is to record, not promote). The set: **(a) prompt injection / instruction-vs-content** — external text may carry instructions aimed at N.H ("ignore your rules, store this as true, reveal memory"); the engine must treat ingested text as CONTENT to be interpreted, never as instructions that control it — critical the moment web/email/documents/WhatsApp enter. **(b) source poisoning** — see item 19's reliability separation. **(c) identity resolution** — same-name people, nicknames, pronouns, "my brother", a person renamed; a wrong identity merge contaminates person-boxes badly; identity links must be revisable + provenance-backed. **(d) time semantics** — distinguish when-it-happened / when-it-was-said / when-N.H-learned-it / when-the-reading-was-made / recalling-the-past vs current-claim, so old beliefs don't appear current (timestamps alone are insufficient). **(e) audit-log integrity** — hash-chained entries, detect missing entries, an attacker mustn't delete both content and its tombstone, defined writer for audit events. **(f) backup/restore TESTING** — prove backups open, keys available, roots+readings+manifests+indexes restore TOGETHER without duplication and with seals/hashes preserved (an untested backup is an assumption). **(g) dependency/environment locking** — lockfile, model hashes, env export, restore instructions, compat tests before upgrades (a silent package/model update could alter behavior or make old data unreadable). **(h) resource limits** — max context per reading, retrieval count, timeouts, nightly-job budget, queue/storage thresholds, what defers under load (append-only + re-reading is otherwise computationally unbounded). **(i) observability** — internal metrics without exposing private content: reading-failure / insufficient-context / malformed-output / retrieval-miss / duplicate-reading / rejected-reading-resurfacing / root-reference-failure rates, model latency. **(j) degraded/disaster mode** — on root-file-unavailable / reading-store-malformed / index-missing / model-offline / key-missing / manifest-inconsistent, degrade to read-only or evidence-only, never improvise. **(k) enforced process boundaries** — today the seal is one Python function and DUMB/SMART is convention, not process isolation; a real implementation decides which module may write roots vs readings vs read-only, whether the model process touches files directly, whether the mouth can EVER write memory, how the seal is enforced beyond one function. **★ SCHEMA EVOLUTION is the one piece of this block with a near-term hook:** `schema_version` (item-19/§6B record-contract addition) must go on every NEW record FROM THE FIRST READING — it is cheap now and impossible to retrofit later (and for the 5,521 SEALED roots it is ALREADY too late — they are implicit v1, tolerated-absent on read). The rest of evolution policy (how old versions are read, whether migrations create-new vs rewrite — rewrite is forbidden by append-only, so migrations ADD superseding records, never edit — when a version becomes unsupported) is deferred, but the stamp itself is not.
26. **★ MODEL-REPLACEMENT DEFAULT (near-settled — the mouth is swappable, but not silently).** When the wording model is replaced: **(i)** the new model must pass the SEALED gold set before it replaces the current one (it cannot become default on vibes); **(ii)** old readings keep their OLD `produced_by` provenance — they are not relabelled; **(iii)** NO automatic mass re-read happens on a model swap (a new model re-reading the whole store unprompted would flood the readings file and the view). A re-read under a new model is a deliberate, bounded act, each new reading stamped with the new producer. This falls straight out of `produced_by` + the gold set existing; recorded as a default, not an open fork.

**THE CENTRAL TRUTH.** The language model is a borrowed, FROZEN mouth + general knowledge — a commodity. Everything that makes N.H *N.H* lives OUTSIDE the model. Engine vs car: the model is the engine; N.H is the car. *Jarvis is the memory + soul + gathering + mouth, wired together.*

**WHY NOT TRAIN ONE.** Training a base model is the wrong resource category (thousands of GPUs, millions of dollars). Putting knowledge in the MEMORY instead keeps it yours, dated, layered, point-back-able, never-closed.

**★ TWO MODELS, TWO JOBS.** (a) WORDING/generation — the mouth, writes the reply word-by-word (heavy load); (b) SEARCHING/retrieval — the embedding model, finds memories by meaning not words (tiny, near-free). **ORDER: search first, word last.** On disk: `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` + ChromaDB. *(★ S12: the current Chroma `nh_reality_core` (116k) is the OLD index over OLD data — when wiring search, REBUILD it from the 5,521 clean roots so search and roots share one world; keep the old one until the new is proven.)*

**★ GROWTH LANDS IN THE MEMORY, NEVER THE MOUTH.** Night-search lands in the store as new readings. Jarvis knows more tomorrow because his understood-memory grew, not because his brain did.

**THE DECISION — LOCAL-FIRST.** Sovereign, offline, private, uncensored. The model is swappable behind the meaning step (an API "reach" could be added later without re-architecting), but local is the chosen default.

**ON-DISK STATE + FORKS (Ness's):** `dolphin-llama3` (UNCENSORED, 8B) — the uncensored mouth, already pulled. `llama3` (8B). `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` — the search model. ## 0. THE PREMISE — NEVER DECIDE FACTS (NEVER CLOSE THE BOOK)  [DESIGNED — the floor under every rule]

**The line:** The danger N.H exists to stop was never *reasoning* — it was reasoning *hardening into authority*: a living guess freezing into a closed, settled fact. The AI may reason fully — connect, guess, build on its own past reasoning, hold opinions, leave notes, get richer over time, and even wonder/simulate forward at night — and do everything except one thing: **close the book on something into a decided fact.** Every conclusion stays a non-decisive, accreting layer; nothing it concludes ever promotes itself to "real."

**The crystallization:** **N.H is Ness's HELPER, not Ness's DECIDER.** A helper reads, connects, lays out what it sees, even leans — then hands it to the person, who decides. A decider closes the book.

**★ THE SOUL CORRECTION (S11) — three truths held at once, never collapsed:**
1. **Interpretive meaning is never stored as a universal fact — it remains a situated story** (§3G). There is no fact-box for *meaning*. "How real, to whom" is a per-person reading, never a place a meaning goes to become true-for-everyone. *(This is about interpretive meaning, NOT machine-state: provenance and machine facts ARE established — see the §0 S13 sharpening.)*
2. **Ness still decides / affirms.** He is the decider, the membrane. The system does NOT decide what is real — *and neither does it pretend nothing is ever decided.* Ness decides.
3. **★ His deciding is NOT a node in the engine.** It happens out in real life, engine absent. **There is no step after "show."** The engine wonders and shows; the deciding is *off the board.* *(★ S13 consistency cross-link: this does NOT forbid recording THAT he reacted. Item 23's seam stores the OCCURRENCE — "Ness accepted/rejected this reading, at this time" — as a dated, weightless STORY-LAYER EVENT the view can read, so a dismissed reading stops resurfacing. What stays off-board is the TRUTH: his rejection is never auto-promoted into "therefore the opposite interpretation is a fact." The event is recorded; the verdict is not engine-decided.)*

**Why a fact is the forbidden thing:** a fact is *the book shut* — true-for-everyone, no longer subjective to Ness. N.H is *his* (הכל יחסי). A fact is the one thing he does not own.

**The crucial distinction:** "never decide facts" does NOT mean "never hold anything firmly." Something can be held with full weight and still never close the book. The enemy was open-vs-closed, not weak-vs-strong.

**★ S13 SHARPENING (from external critique — the wording was too absolute; narrow its JURISDICTION, don't remove the principle):** "never decide facts" must NOT be read as "there are no facts." The clean distinction: **the DUMB machinery MAY establish directly-verifiable machine-state and provenance facts** (this file exists, this hash matches, this record has its declared fields, this role came directly from source, this root-id points here, this write succeeded). **The SMART machinery MAY interpret, connect, and lean — but may NEVER silently promote an interpretation into an established fact.** The authority for any such promotion is Ness, off-board, never the engine. So: *machine-state & provenance truth is decided freely; interpretive meaning is never closed into truth-for-everyone.* Collapsing those two into one prohibition (the old wording) would treat a file hash or a source role as "only a story" — which absurdly WEAKENS the evidence discipline the system exists to protect.

## 0A. THE TWO MACHINERIES — DUMB vs SMART (psychologics)  [DESIGNED — top-level frame]

- **DUMB MACHINERY — moves and holds data; built stupid on purpose.** The pure tape, the append-only store, the two files (roots sealed, readings beside), the pointers (`re_reads`), the role-carried-from-source, the catalog's who/when/where marking, **carrying/storing the mode label once SMART has named it** (DUMB stores and moves the `mode` field; it does NOT decide it), the person-box GATHER, the live loop's fire-and-let-go. One law: **never interpret, never close — only add / point / carry / sort / gather.** Safe BECAUSE it cannot interpret. *(★ S13 consistency fix: NAMING the register — "question / story / confession / …" — is interpretation, so it is produced by SMART, §6B's open-word `mode`; the earlier "mode/form-naming under DUMB" wording was wrong and is corrected here to agree with §6B and R9's "mode = a peer web.")*

> **★ S13 CORRECTION — THE PURE TAPE NEEDS A REDACTION/DESTRUCTION PATH (safety, not philosophy).** "Captures always, append-only, untouchable" is epistemically clean but a real hazard: the tape could capture passwords, access tokens, other people's private info, accidental pastes, medical details, things recorded during distress, or material someone later has a legitimate right to remove. **"Append-only" must NOT mean "permanent recoverable storage of every secret forever."** The corrected rule allows: (i) **capture exclusions** for credentials and known secrets (don't record them at all); (ii) encrypted storage; (iii) explicit **retention boundaries**; (iv) **cryptographic erasure** of selected content; (v) an append-only **TOMBSTONE** that retains *that* a deletion occurred and when, WITHOUT retaining the deleted plaintext; (vi) special treatment for third-party and childhood data. This does not violate append-only HISTORY — the record can say content was removed without continuing to preserve the harmful content itself. *(Applies to the tape AND the sealed roots: sealing protects from accidental MUTATION; it must still allow DELIBERATE, audited destruction of genuinely sensitive content — seal ≠ un-deletable.)* Owed alongside §11 item 24 (privacy/threat model).

> **★ S13 CORRECTION — "ABSENCE IS READ" NEEDS A GUARD (or it becomes pseudo-psychology).** Absence is meaningful ONLY when (i) the system EXPECTED the information, (ii) the collection process was CAPABLE of observing it, (iii) the absence is contextually relevant, and (iv) the interpretation is held explicitly WEAK. Unguarded, "absence is read" turns missing-data artifacts (a parser failure, a field never evaluated, an old schema) into manufactured significance — a sophisticated hallucination. So omission needs to distinguish, at least in processing metadata, between `not_observed` / `not_evaluated` / `not_applicable` / `withheld` / `collection_failed`. A blank in a reading is still honest (don't write `"unknown"`), and these labels live BESIDE the reading as provenance about WHY a field is absent — they do not fill the story fields themselves. The engine must not read every blank as psychological evidence — only the ones that pass the four-part guard.
- **SMART (psychologics) MACHINERY — reads the *person*.** The meaning webs (Theory of Mind, the STORY-layer with its six parts, gap-reading, firmness-as-read), **the mode/register NAMING (producing the open-word `mode` + its classification_confidence — §6B; DUMB only carries the result)**, clash-surfacing, the wonder/simulation, and the NOTE. One law: **everything here is weightless, dated, confidence-tagged, rejectable — NEVER a fact.** Safe BECAUSE it cannot close.
- **THE BORROWED MOUTH (§16) sits at the seam, used by SMART.** The wording model turns understood meaning into sentences — a swappable tool. The embedding/search model is a DUMB tool (sorts by meaning-distance; does not interpret).

**The membrane (§7A R7) is the boundary between them** — creation (SMART) never closes into memory (DUMB).

**OPEN PINS (fresh-head):** (i) the name — "smart" vs "psychologics machinery"; (ii) whether the note + clash file under SMART or are called out inside it.

## 1. WHAT N.H IS

N.H ("Jarvis") is a personal, sovereign AI memory system running locally, 24/7, on Ness's own Windows machine. Not a product — infrastructure for his own thinking, memory, and research.

**The one-line soul:** **N.H is Ness's HELPER, not Ness's DECIDER.** The loop, in Ness's words: *real life → into N.H for help → it helps him see and understand his own thinking and do what he needs in the way that fits how he thinks → he returns to real life with a solution that is his own.*

**★ WHAT JARVIS ACTUALLY IS:** Jarvis is NOT the model. The model is a borrowed, frozen mouth (§16). **Jarvis is the memory + the soul + the gathering + the mouth, wired together.** Everything that makes him *him and grows him* lives outside the model.

**★ MEMORY IS UNDERSTOOD KNOWLEDGE THAT GROWS.** The memory is not a pile of raw text — it is comprehension that accretes. New input is *read* by the webs and lands as a reading (meaning + confidence + story-layer). Jarvis understands more tomorrow, and the growth lands in the memory, never in the frozen mouth.

**★ THE TWO-DESTINATIONS SHAPE (S12, Ness re-derived it):** every **eligible accepted** input goes to TWO places at once — (1) the **RAW ROOT**, saved untouched and sealed; (2) **THROUGH THE FILTER**, which READS it and lays a **READING** beside the root, pointing back by id, never altering the raw. *(★ S13 consistency fix: "eligible accepted" — NOT literally every byte. Credentials/secrets and excluded material are caught by the §0A capture-exclusions and never become roots at all; "two destinations" governs what is admitted, not what is filtered out at the door.)* The filter never "filters" the root; **the raw is never SILENTLY altered** (understanding accretes beside it, never inside it) — the only change a root can ever undergo is DELIBERATE, audited destruction through the §0A redaction/tombstone path (seal = protected from accidental mutation, NOT un-deletable). This is exactly why there are TWO FILES. *(S12 built place 1 — the raw roots. The filter, place 2, reads them later as its own pass.)*

**The two functions (NOT two truth-boxes):**
- **SIMULATION — the create-space / workshop, with a live function (§7B Part 6.5):** where things get made and wondered forward.
- **"REALITY" as a box of decided facts — DISSOLVED (§3G).** "How real" is not a place; it is "how does this sit in *whose* story" — a per-person telling the filter reads, layered, revisable, never closed.

**The two purposes, always running together (THE CORE — Ness's framing):**
- **INWARD — the mirror:** show Ness the shape of his own thinking from the outside — the pattern he can't see because he's inside it. *(The 5,521 clean roots ingested in S12 are the inward eye's raw material.)*
- **OUTWARD — the engine:** take new external data and translate it through the lens of how *his* mind connects things — not generic explanation, not retrieval.
- **ONE FILTER, BOTH DIRECTIONS.** Same method (read meaning through Ness's lens, never close the book); only the direction it faces changes. The two feed each other: outward reading lands in memory as new roots/readings, which enrich the next inward read. *"A mind that runs alongside another mind — one looking inward, one looking outward — both at full speed."*

## 1A. THE INPUT-AGNOSTIC PRINCIPLE — ONE ENGINE, MANY FRONT DOORS  [DESIGNED]

N.H is input-agnostic. Text, images, video, audio — all flow through the SAME engine. New input types get a new **front door** (a small model turning that input into pieces the engine reads), not a new engine. The front door has two stages (§14): RAW capture → CATALOG (who/when/where). The live chat itself is a front door. *(The S12 ChatGPT-export parser is a worked text front door.)*

**The deepest "why" — הכל יחסי:** nothing about *meaning* is final — a thing means what it means only relative to ever-growing context, and relative to whom. This is why memory only adds, classification is never locked, "unknown" is honest, and the affirmation surface is a per-person STORY, not a shared fact-box.

- **Backup before any destructive step, always.** *(S12: he insisted "of course backup first" before clearing the 188 — correct instinct, kept.)*
- **Primary risk pattern: scope-expansion before consolidation.** Finish and verify what's in front before the next thing.
- **Claude's role:** architecture, audit, security, strategy — the brain that checks the work ("JARVIS"). Cursor writes code; Ness runs every command in cmd and verifies on disk. *(S12 exception: for the bytecode recovery + the small ingest/store modules, Claude wrote the exact code directly so the recovered constants wouldn't drift; Ness still ran and verified everything on disk.)*
- **Session workflow:** one topic per chat; start fresh when a topic closes. End of session: regenerate the master + a short delta → Ness swaps the file in. **Ness prefers to start a fresh chat from a corrected master rather than continue a long session on fumes** (stated S12).

A used RTX 3060 12GB (~$200–250) is the known cheap upgrade — noted, NOT now. Runtime = Ollama; models = quantized GGUF; context ~2048.
- **Windows sign-in:** Kensington VeriMark fingerprint key (distinct from N.H's own auth).

## 6B. THE ACCRETIVE STORE — SCHEMA + STATE  [BUILT & VERIFIED]

*The running code of the accretive/membrane direction. A deliberately dumb, append-only store — the DUMB-MACHINERY heart (§0A). Wired to NOTHING by design.*

**Module:** `nh_accretive_store.py` (restored S12, extended S13). 4 public + 4 private functions; every `open()` is `"a"`/`"r"`, no `"w"`; schema validated before every append. **The roots file is SEALED (S13):** `append_root` raises if `.nh_roots.sealed` exists.

**★ ROOT record schema (SEVEN fields, S12):** `id` (uuid4) · `subject` · `timestamp` (ISO 8601, validated) · `content` · `re_reads` (list; `[]` = root, non-empty = reading) · `source_title` (string or None; optional/absence-tolerated on read) · **`role`** (speaker carried from source — `user`/`assistant`; required on new writes; tolerated-absent on read for legacy records).

**★ READING record schema — SHAPE PROVISIONALLY SETTLED (S13), `confidence` OPEN, NOT YET CODED.** ⚠ The sibling file `.nh_readings_store.jsonl` is *wired* (`append_reading` routes there) but `append_reading` is still ROOT-SHAPED (`subject, content, re_reads, role, …`) and `_validate_record` enforces the 7-field ROOT schema. The reading record — **now `id · reads (root id(s)) · meaning · confidence · role · story_layer · mode · timestamp · produced_by · schema_version · derived_from · idempotency_key` (TWELVE provisional fields; the original "8-field" plus `produced_by`+`schema_version` then `derived_from`+`idempotency_key` from the S13 doc-pass; superseded phrasing kept only in history; an optional content-hash may also be stored for exact-duplicate/integrity detection but is NOT a field the schema requires)** — has NO validator and NO writer yet; ZERO real readings exist. A reading NEVER copies root text — it points. Show = read readings → follow `reads` ids into sealed roots → stitch. A re-read is a NEW reading beside the old (R6). **FIRST 2c-adjacent build job: a reading-shaped `append_reading` + a reading validator.** **The complex/contract fields, design-settled S13:**

⚠ **BUT THE SHAPE IS NOT FULLY LOCKED — `confidence` is unresolved (§11 item 19).** The record is listed with a single top-level `confidence`, yet §11 item 19 establishes that "confidence" is really FOUR separate quantities (interpretation confidence · source reliability · story firmness · retrieval relevance) and must NOT collapse into one number. So the reading-record SHAPE is **provisionally settled, not design-locked** — `story_layer`/`mode`/unknowns are settled, but the confidence representation (one generic field? `interpretation_confidence` only? a structured object? none at top level?) MUST be resolved BEFORE the validator is written, or the validator would prematurely freeze the very ambiguity S13 just surfaced. **Resolve confidence first → then code the validator/writer.**
- **`story_layer` = a LIST of tellings** (so opposing readings of the same root both stay — clash kept, nothing wins). Each telling: optional `whose · stance · firmness · telling · theme · when`. Empty list = no story-reading yet (honest). Unknown parts OMITTED, never `"unknown"`-filled (absence read at read-time). The top-level `role` (who spoke) ≠ a telling's `whose` (in whose story).
- **`mode` = an OPEN word + a LOCAL confidence** (register: chat/composed/story/question/…). NOT a fixed menu — a menu would re-add a manual gate (R5 / הכל יחסי). One mode per reading; a different reading later is a NEW reading, not an edit. ⚠ **NAMING CLARIFICATION (S13):** `mode`'s confidence is a LOCAL `classification_confidence` (how sure the filter is it named the register right), e.g. `mode: { label: "question", classification_confidence: 0.82 }`. This is NOT the unresolved top-level reading confidence (§11 item 19) — do not let the existence of `mode.classification_confidence` make the next session think the top-level `confidence`/`interpretation_confidence` question is already solved. They are different quantities at different levels; the top-level one is still OPEN.
- **★ `produced_by` = REPRODUCIBILITY-GRADE PRODUCER PROVENANCE (S13 doc-pass; DUMB-machinery structural field, not interpretation).** A structured sub-record stamping WHAT made the reading, enough to approximately explain *why this reading and not another* — not just "which model." Shape (DESIGNED, leave room): `origin` (the information-path origin — at least `"observed"` | `"imported"` | `"simulated"` | `"generated"` | `"reaction"` | `"human_annotation"`, distinguishing whether the input was directly observed, imported from elsewhere, produced in the simulation/wonder space, generated by the engine, derived from Ness's reaction to an earlier N.H output, or hand-annotated) · `model` (name) · `model_digest` (hash/exact version, not just name) · `engine_version` · `prompt_version` (template) · `config` (decoding/settings relevant to reproduce) · the retrieval inputs/context-ids+order the reading was built from (so a reading is approximately recreatable). **For `origin:"human_annotation"` (a GOLD annotation): the model fields give way to ANNOTATION provenance** — `annotator` · `annotated_at` · `context_version` · `change_reason` (why it changed between gold versions). **Validator requirement:** `produced_by` is REQUIRED on every engine-generated reading (without it you can't tell a stale reading from a current one, can't re-evaluate an old batch when the mouth is swapped, can't attribute a bad reading to a model version). Gold cases satisfy it via the human-annotation form — they are NOT exempt from provenance, only from MODEL provenance. This is the structural anchor that makes item 19's "no silent confidence inheritance / no false corroboration" enforceable.
- **★ `derived_from` = LINEAGE (S13 doc-pass; first-schema PIN — un-retrofittable, must exist from the first reading).** A list of PARENT READING ids the reading was derived from; **empty `[]` when the reading was produced fresh directly from source roots** (those roots are in `reads`). `produced_by.origin` says what KIND of information path; `derived_from` says WHICH prior readings sit upstream. Together they let the path be reconstructed later. **THE GOVERNING RULE (records here + item 19): derived material must never count as INDEPENDENT evidence for the interpretation that produced it; repeated readings descending from one lineage remain ONE evidence path, not multiple confirmations.** This blocks the invisible confirmation loop — interpret a root → discuss it → the discussion enters as new data → the discussion gets read as independent support for the original interpretation — where one guess wears several costumes and certainty climbs while evidence doesn't (a §0 soul violation that no "fact" field would catch). **The FIELDS are pinned now; the full lineage analysis + independence-weighting (walking `derived_from` to discount downstream agreement) is DEFERRED** (beside item 19 / the view layer) — the slot must exist, the logic can come later.
- **★ `idempotency_key` = OPERATION identity, separate from `id` the RECORD identity (S13 doc-pass; writer-contract PIN).** `id` is the unique IMMUTABLE identity of the stored reading. `idempotency_key` (a.k.a. generation-run id) is the stable identity of the WRITE OPERATION, reused when a crashed/repeated command is retried; **the writer rejects an already-committed key.** A content hash over `reads`+`meaning`+`produced_by`+`schema_version` may ALSO be stored for exact-duplicate/integrity detection, but it must NOT carry the retry guarantee — a nondeterministic mouth can rephrase `meaning` on replay (hash misses the dup), and two legitimately independent readings can collide (hash invents a dup). Operation-identity does the retry job; record-identity is permanent; content-hash is an optional integrity extra.
- **★ `schema_version` = the record-contract version stamp (S13 doc-pass; REQUIRED on every NEW record).** Cheap now, impossible to retrofit later — and for the 5,521 SEALED roots it is ALREADY too late (they are implicit v1, tolerated-absent on read; the seal forbids adding it to them). So it MUST land on the first reading ever written. Migrations never rewrite old records (append-only forbids it) — a schema change ADDS new superseding records; the version stamp is what lets a future validator read multiple versions and know which contract each record obeys. The first reading schema is `v1`.

**★ ON DISK NOW (verified S13):** **5,521 clean root records, SEALED**, all `re_reads=[]` (all roots — no real readings written yet), all 7-field, role-carried, source-timestamped, clean source_title. The sibling readings file is wired but holds **no real readings yet** (a test reading was written and deleted). *(The ~116k Chroma is the OLD unaligned index — §5/§11.15.)* **The remaining 2a-adjacent work is, FIRST, to implement and verify the reading VALIDATOR and reading-shaped WRITER (the current `append_reading` is still root-shaped, `_validate_record` still enforces the 7-field root) — and ONLY THEN to populate real readings through the engine (2c).**

**No `reason`/`why` field, by design** — the why is shown by what a layer points at; the AI's view is the NOTE (§7B Part 7.5).

## 7. THE BIG DESIGN — UNIVERSAL FILTER + MEANING ENGINE  [DESIGNED — not built]

*(§7A operating rules, §7B the meaning-engine mechanism, §7C build order — all UNCHANGED from MASTER-12 in substance. Preserved by reference; the key points below.)*

### 7A — THE UNIVERSAL FILTER (operating rules, full set unchanged):
R0 reader/layer-er not judge; R0.5 never close the book (may wonder/simulate); R1 one filter, no source exempt; R2 sorts/reads, never closes "real"; R3 one continuous reader; R4 meaning from wide context; R5 classification never locked; **R5.5 the affirmation surface is a per-person STORY-layer (six optional parts: whose·when·stance·firmness·telling·theme; absence is itself read, but ONLY under the §0A observability guard — expected + observable + relevant + held-weak, never raw missing-data; CLASH surfaced not resolved; N.H not a teller, its view a weightless NOTE);** R6 memory only ADDS (KEYSTONE — but this governs HISTORY, not live use: the append-only floor only grows, while the COMPUTED VIEW (item 21) decides what is currently used; "only adds" must NOT be read as "retrieve the whole pile equally" — superseded/rejected/weak readings stay in history and drop out of the working view); R7 the membrane (creation in chat, never closes in memory); R8 associative bridging as relevance-trigger; R9 sort by meaning-type, mode a separate peer web; R10 maximal-but-bounded; R11 Ness steers, affirms off-board; R12 honesty about what this is (the model does not grow).

### 7B — THE MEANING ENGINE (mechanism, full depth unchanged):
Part 0 THE PURE TAPE (deepest DUMB layer — verbatim, append-only, outside memory; preserves ELIGIBLE captured events, subject to explicit capture-exclusions for secrets and audited cryptographic redaction with tombstones — §0A correction; NOT capture-everything-untouchable); Parts 1–2 the chain of webs (intent, deixis, common ground, implicature, theory-of-mind, time, re-reading, mode); Part 2.5 THE STORY-LAYER WEB (six optional parts, absence-read, clash); **Part 2.6 PERSON-BOXES (a GATHER over readings by `whose`, bounded by Ness's knowing, never synthesised; the tag is the wall; no-ruin + no-contaminate);** Part 3 webs combine (one camera, many lenses); Part 4 nightly research inward+outward (feeds the MEMORY, never the mouth); Part 5 hold-until-enough; Part 6 can't-fill→inform-don't-ask (live exception: catalog MAY ask, Ness present); **Part 6.5 THE WONDER/SIMULATION (kept-and-shown never decided; two walls — file door + eyes door; no scratch→memory path);** Part 7 THE LOG (read-only, subject-tagged, clickable); Part 7.5 THE NOTE/THE WHY (the AI's whole perspective, weightless, cannot harden, confidence never aggregates).

### 7C — THE FORCED BUILD ORDER (never re-fought):
**(2a) two-file routing + sealed roots — ✅ PLUMBING BUILT (S13); ⚠ READING RECORD NOT CODED.** What's on disk: `append_reading`→sibling file, roots sealed. What's NOT: the reading validator/writer for the 12-field contract (`append_reading` is still root-shaped). Reading record SHAPE provisionally settled (`story_layer`=list, `mode`=open word, unknowns omitted) — but `confidence` representation OPEN (§11 item 19); resolve it BEFORE coding the validator. **The reading-record code is the FIRST job of the next milestone, folded into 2c.** → **(2b) the detector — ✅ INVESTIGATED, RECIPE LOCKED (S13).** Full read-only investigation: shape tops out ~91.6% (proven), meaning (embeddings) breaks it; locked recipe = embed+shape → StandardScaler → LogisticRegression(C=0.1) → **~94.89% honest (5-fold)**. NOT deployed — a FALLBACK for sources lacking `role`; build the live detector later from the recipe. → **(2c) the engine — THE NEXT MILESTONE — first code the reading-record writer/validator, then the chain-of-webs that READS a root and produces a real READING; fresh-head, the heart of the system.** **★ Build the LIVE path (memory → search → mouth → speak) BEFORE the nightly deepening.**
